prevention.testId: enforces the read-only policy for SQLite-native mutation paths
prevention.expectedAssertion: SQLite-native mutation paths are denied and a following SELECT succeeds.

recovery.testId: opens a local database and renders a bounded query result
recovery.expectedAssertion: A valid read query renders bounded rows after the policy boundary is exercised.

risks.title: Cancellation can be queued behind synchronous SQLite work

prevention.testId: measures ${sizeMiB} MiB import, cancel/reopen, reimport, and query recovery
prevention.expectedAssertion: Cancel acknowledges within the qualified budget and stale worker responses do not publish.

recovery.testId: resets the worker-backed workspace without retaining the database view
recovery.expectedAssertion: Worker-backed state can be reset to an explicit no-database state without stale results.

risks.title: File, statement, cell, BLOB, and result limits can exhaust memory

prevention.testId: renders at most one result page in the DOM while retaining the bounded result model
prevention.expectedAssertion: Result rows, cells, and rendered DOM remain within configured bounds.

recovery.testId: opens an oversized catalog in bounded searchable mode
recovery.expectedAssertion: An oversized catalog enters bounded mode and SELECT 1 remains usable.

risks.title: Unreadable, WAL-dependent, encrypted, or corrupt input can be misclassified

prevention.testId: keeps a malformed view isolated from healthy catalog objects
prevention.expectedAssertion: Malformed metadata is isolated while healthy catalog objects remain visible.

recovery.testId: rejects SQLite sidecar files before opening them
recovery.expectedAssertion: A sidecar is rejected before worker intake and the no-database state remains actionable.

risks.title: Database-derived names and values can reach an executable UI sink

prevention.testId: renders hostile query-plan detail as inert text
prevention.expectedAssertion: Hostile identifiers render as text and do not create executable DOM nodes.

recovery.testId: quotes unusual catalog identifiers in bounded SELECT actions
recovery.expectedAssertion: Quoted identifiers produce a safe bounded SELECT and remain queryable.

risks.title: SQLite schema features can be silently omitted from the catalog

prevention.testId: keeps FTS4 and RTree virtual modules visible with bounded shadow metadata
prevention.expectedAssertion: FTS4, RTree, virtual, and shadow metadata remain explicitly visible and bounded.

recovery.testId: represents virtual and shadow objects without losing the virtual table
recovery.expectedAssertion: A virtual table remains discoverable after shadow-object normalization.

risks.title: Duplicate result names and SQLite dynamic values can be changed or lost

prevention.testId: keeps duplicate labels positional and neutralizes CSV formulas
prevention.expectedAssertion: Duplicate columns retain positional identity and formula-like CSV cells are neutralized.

recovery.testId: shows a read-only query plan, exports the result, and keeps bounded history
recovery.expectedAssertion: The result can be planned, exported, and revisited without losing exact values.

risks.title: Large schema/layout or wide result can block the main thread

prevention.testId: opens an oversized catalog in bounded searchable mode
prevention.expectedAssertion: Large catalog intake stays searchable, paginated, and diagram-safe.

recovery.testId: keeps limited catalogs and result pages structurally bounded
recovery.expectedAssertion: Catalog and result structural budgets hold while a bounded query remains usable.

risks.title: CSV formula injection or misleading truncated export can harm users

prevention.testId: keeps duplicate labels positional and neutralizes CSV formulas
prevention.expectedAssertion: Formula-like text is apostrophe-prefixed in CSV and truncation remains explicit.

recovery.testId: completes the primary workflow without pointer-only actions
recovery.expectedAssertion: Export remains reachable in the primary workflow and acknowledges a bounded download.

risks.title: History or logging can persist database-derived secrets

prevention.testId: shows a read-only query plan, exports the result, and keeps bounded history
prevention.expectedAssertion: History is bounded to SQL metadata and does not retain result cell values.

recovery.testId: keeps the current SQL draft when generated-join replacement is cancelled
recovery.expectedAssertion: A cancelled generated action preserves only the SQL draft and leaves the workspace usable.

risks.title: Service-worker updates or cache cleanup can damage sibling apps

prevention.testId: reloads the complete shell offline without deleting sibling caches
prevention.expectedAssertion: Offline shell reload succeeds while a sibling cache survives and database files are absent.

recovery.testId: registers the app shell without caching database files
recovery.expectedAssertion: The shell registers and its cache excludes imported database files.

risks.title: CSP, worker, WASM, or static subpath behavior can differ in production

prevention.testId: keeps the worker and database workflow same-origin and non-isolated
prevention.expectedAssertion: Worker, WASM, and database workflow stay same-origin with no external runtime requests.

recovery.testId: blocks intake when a required browser capability is missing
recovery.expectedAssertion: Missing Worker capability fails closed with a visible recovery state before file intake.

risks.title: Canvas-first ER interaction can exclude keyboard and screen-reader users

prevention.testId: completes the primary workflow without pointer-only actions
prevention.expectedAssertion: Open, query, plan, relationship, join, export, history, and theme actions are keyboard reachable.

recovery.testId: keeps the primary workflow contained and accessible at ${viewport.name} width
recovery.expectedAssertion: The semantic workflow remains contained and axe-clean across responsive viewport variants.

risks.title: Mock-heavy tests can pass while real SQLite WASM/browser behavior fails

prevention.testId: opens the bundled sample and runs the fixed readiness check
prevention.expectedAssertion: The bundled SQLite WASM sample opens and executes the fixed readiness query in a real browser.

recovery.testId: opens a local database and renders a bounded query result
recovery.expectedAssertion: A real local SQLite file opens and renders exact bounded result values.
